skill.name: seo-content-auditor
skill.description: Analyzes provided content for quality, E-E-A-T signals, and SEO best practices. Scores content and provides improvement recommendations based on established guidelines.
skill.summary: Audits supplied content for SEO quality, E-E-A-T signals, readability, structure, and actionable improvement opportunities.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives caused by ordinary Markdown prose. The skill contains no executable commands, network reconnaissance instructions, or semantic evidence of malicious intent.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks delimit a Markdown path to a referenced resource file. They do not invoke Ruby, a shell, or any external command.
The line is a content-audit checklist item about topic depth. It contains no host discovery, port scanning, network request, or reconnaissance instruction.

content.user_title: Audit SEO Content for Quality and Trust
content.value_statement: Content teams need clear evidence of quality, readability, and trust gaps before publishing. This skill audits supplied text and recommends specific SEO improvements.
actual_capabilities: Scores content depth, E-E-A-T signals, readability, and keyword optimization.
Reviews heading structure, organization, paragraph length, and clarity.
Identifies missing topics, citations, author expertise, and trust indicators.
Assesses keyword density, distribution, and semantic relevance in supplied text.
Suggests internal linking opportunities and prioritized content improvements.
Produces a structured audit report with category scores and recommendations.
limitations: Cannot check live search rankings or search engine results pages.
Cannot access search volume, engagement data, or technical SEO metrics.
Cannot compare competitor content unless the user supplies it.
Cannot verify whether citations, credentials, statistics, or claims are accurate.

use_cases.title: Review a Draft Article
use_cases.description: Audit a draft before publication for depth, readability, keyword usage, and missing trust signals.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Website Copy
use_cases.description: Find weak sections, missing subtopics, and structure problems in an existing page.

use_cases.title: Standardize Editorial Reviews
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent audit format across content produced by several contributors.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Content Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the following content for depth, readability, structure, and trust signals. Provide category scores and prioritized recommendations: [paste content]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a first review of a single draft.

prompt_templates.title: Keyword-Focused Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this content for the primary keyword [keyword] and related concepts. Assess placement, distribution, natural usage, structure, and missing subtopics: [paste content]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a target keyword is already defined.

prompt_templates.title: E-E-A-T Improvement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content for visible experience, expertise, authority, and trust signals. Identify unsupported claims, missing evidence, and concrete credibility improvements: [paste content]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for sensitive or expertise-driven topics.

prompt_templates.title: Comprehensive Editorial Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this page for audience [audience] and goal [goal]. Evaluate depth, E-E-A-T, readability, keywords, structure, trust, and unique value. Prioritize revisions by impact: [paste content]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a detailed review aligned with audience and business goals.

output_examples.input: Audit a beginner guide with long paragraphs, few headings, and no cited sources.
output_examples.output: Readability: 5/10. Break long paragraphs into focused sections. Add descriptive headings, cite reliable sources, and include author expertise details.

output_examples.input: Review a product page targeting project management software.
output: Content depth: 6/10. Add workflow examples and clear feature outcomes.
Keyword optimization: 7/10. Use related terms naturally in headings and body text.
Trust: 4/10. Add customer evidence, transparent pricing details, and verifiable claims.

output_examples.input: Assess an article that covers the main topic but omits common reader questions.
output_examples.output: The core topic is covered, but comprehensiveness is limited. Add sections addressing setup, costs, common problems, and practical next steps.

best_practices: Provide the complete content, target audience, primary keyword, and publishing goal.
Validate suggested facts, citations, and credentials with reliable sources before publication.
Apply recommendations by impact, then review the revised content for clarity and natural language.
anti_patterns: Do not request live ranking, traffic, or search volume analysis without supplying external data.
Do not add keywords repeatedly when they reduce clarity or sound unnatural.
Do not treat category scores as verified search performance predictions.

faq.question: What content can this skill audit?
faq.answer: It can audit supplied articles, landing pages, guides, and website copy for content quality and on-page SEO signals.

faq.question: Does it check live Google rankings?
faq.answer: No. It cannot access live rankings or search engine results.

faq.question: Can it analyze competitor pages?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide the competitor content. It cannot retrieve competitor pages independently.

faq.question: Does it verify citations and statistics?
faq.answer: No. It identifies missing or weak evidence, but users must verify each source and claim.

faq.question: What information improves the audit?
faq.answer: Provide the full text, target audience, primary keyword, content goal, and any relevant performance data.

faq.question: Can it audit technical SEO?
faq.answer: No. It does not inspect page speed, crawlability, structured data, indexing, or other technical metrics.
